scope: Available saved records in the original and three replacement hosted-model roots, plus the initial and environmental-recovery local roots, for the 288 reported cells only.
selection_rule: Hosted-model cells use the fix_r7 v2 record; when it has an environmental failure, use the non-environmental v2c record if present, otherwise the non-environmental v2b record. Original cells remain for provenance. GPT-OSS attempt-2 environmental failures are replaced by the saved environmental-recovery record.
cost_scope: Only the selected first-attempt record contributes to tokens.json. Predecessor and other-attempt records in this ledger are not added to those totals.
environmental_scope: Cause labels reproduce the saved builder rule using only fixed error markers and numeric/status receipts; no raw streams or authentication data are included. Original runtime classifications remain unchanged.
